name: Routing, Layout & Navigation
description: Implements the routing data model and layout shell for the exemplar.tools documentation website. Includes: (1) ROUTE_SLUG_MAP constant mapping all 13 routes (home + 12 steps) with leading-slash values as a Record<StepId, RouteSlug>, (2) ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST ordered array of 13 RouteEntry objects defining sidebar order and route registration sequence, (3) ensureLeadingSlash slug guard utility using the exact ternary from operating procedures, (4) a persistent Sidebar component with NavLinks to all pages highlighting the active route (home NavLink uses `end` prop), (5) a Layout component wrapping sidebar + content area with React Router <Outlet />, (6) route registration in App.tsx using createBrowserRouter with Layout as parent route element and all 13 pages as children. All use React Router v6 browser history mode. Tests verify all 13 routes exist, no double-slash bugs, slug guard edge cases, sidebar renders all links, and all slugs are unique.

types.name: RouteSlug
types.description: All 14 valid route slugs (leading-slash paths) used for navigation and route registration across the app.

types.name: StepId
types.description: Unique identifier for each step in the exemplar.tools pipeline, used as keys in content data and pipeline diagram nodes.

types.name: StepLabel
types.description: Human-readable display labels for each pipeline step, shown in sidebar navigation, diagram boxes, and page titles.

types.name: RouteEntry

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL path slug for this route (always starts with '/').

fields.name: label
fields.description: Human-readable label displayed in navigation and page headers.

types.description: A single entry in the route map linking a step to its slug and display label, consumed by sidebar nav and route registration.

types.name: RouteEntryList
types.description: Ordered list of all 14 RouteEntry items, defining sidebar order and route registration sequence.

types.name: RouteSlugMap
types.description: Record<StepId, RouteSlug> providing O(1) lookup from step ID to its URL slug. Derived from ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST via Array.reduce — never independently maintained.

types.name: ReactNode
types.description: React.ReactNode — the return type of React functional components. Represents any renderable React content.

types.name: NavLinkClassName
types.description: The className callback signature for React Router NavLink: ({ isActive }: { isActive: boolean }) => string. Returns Tailwind classes for active/inactive states.

types.name: RouterConfig

fields.name: element
fields.description: The Layout component instance wrapping Sidebar + Outlet

fields.name: children
fields.description: Array of child route objects, one per ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST entry, each with path and element props

types.description: Configuration object returned by createBrowserRouter. Represents the complete route tree with Layout as the parent route and all 13 page routes as children.

functions.name: ensureLeadingSlash
functions.description: Pure utility function that guarantees a string has exactly one leading slash. Uses the exact ternary from operating procedures: `slug.startsWith('/') ? slug : '/' + slug`. Does NOT strip double slashes — that is a separate concern validated by invariants on ROUTE_SLUG_MAP values.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: A URL slug string that may or may not already have a leading slash.

preconditions: slug is a string (may be empty)
postconditions: Return value always starts with '/'
If input already starts with '/', return value equals input unchanged
If input does not start with '/', return value equals '/' + input
Empty string input returns '/'

structured_side_effects.description: Pure function — no side effects. Performs only string inspection and concatenation.

functions.name: Sidebar
functions.description: React functional component that renders a vertical navigation sidebar. Iterates over ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST and renders one React Router NavLink per entry, using entry.slug as the `to` prop and entry.label as the link text. Uses NavLink's className callback `({ isActive }) => string` to apply Tailwind active/inactive styles. The home NavLink (slug='/') uses the `end` prop to prevent it from matching all routes. Styled with Tailwind for fixed-width left sidebar positioning.

error_cases.name: no_router_context
error_cases.condition: Sidebar is rendered outside of a React Router context

error_data.message: useLocation() may be used only in the context of a <Router> component

preconditions: Component must be rendered within a React Router context (BrowserRouter, MemoryRouter, or RouterProvider)
ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST must be available as an import from the routing module
postconditions: Renders exactly 13 NavLink elements, one per entry in ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST
NavLinks appear in the same order as ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST
The home NavLink (slug='/') has the `end` prop set to true
Each NavLink's `to` prop matches the corresponding entry's slug value
Each NavLink displays the corresponding entry's label as text content
Active NavLink receives distinct Tailwind classes for visual highlighting

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function. NavLink click handlers are provided by React Router, not by this component.

functions.name: Layout
functions.description: React functional component that renders the top-level page layout shell. Uses a Tailwind flex container with Sidebar on the left and a main content area on the right containing React Router's <Outlet /> component. The Outlet renders the matched child route's component. Layout is used as the `element` of the root route in createBrowserRouter configuration.

error_cases.name: no_router_context
error_cases.condition: Layout is rendered outside of a React Router context

error_data.message: useOutlet() may be used only in the context of a <Router> component

preconditions: Component must be rendered within a React Router context
Sidebar component must be available as an import
React Router Outlet must be available
postconditions: Renders a flex container with exactly two children: Sidebar and a main content wrapper
The main content wrapper contains exactly one <Outlet /> component
Sidebar is positioned on the left side of the flex container
The main content area fills the remaining horizontal space

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function. Layout delegates routing behavior to React Router's Outlet.

functions.name: createAppRouter
functions.description: Factory function that creates and returns a React Router v6 browser router instance using createBrowserRouter. Constructs the route tree with Layout as the parent route element (path='/') and all 13 page routes as children. Child route paths are derived from ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST entries: home uses `index: true`, all others use `path: entry.slug.slice(1)` (removing the leading slash since they are relative to the parent). Each child route's element is the corresponding page component, lazy-loaded or directly imported.

error_cases.name: missing_page_component
error_cases.condition: A page component referenced in ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST cannot be resolved at import time

error_data.message: Cannot find module for route entry stepId

preconditions: All page components referenced by route entries must be importable
React Router createBrowserRouter must be available
postconditions: Returns a valid router instance with exactly 1 parent route and 13 child routes
Parent route has path '/' and element <Layout />
Home child route uses `index: true` instead of `path: ''`
All non-home child routes have paths matching their slug without the leading slash
Router uses browser history mode (not hash or memory)

structured_side_effects.description: Creates a router configuration object. Does not mount to DOM or trigger navigation. The router object is inert until passed to <RouterProvider>.

functions.name: getNavLinkClassName
functions.description: Pure helper function that returns the className callback for NavLink components. Given an isActive boolean from React Router's NavLink render prop, returns the appropriate Tailwind CSS class string for active or inactive navigation link styling.

inputs.name: isActive
inputs.description: Whether the NavLink's route matches the current URL, provided by React Router's NavLink className callback.

postconditions: When isActive is true, returns a class string containing active state Tailwind classes (e.g., font-bold, specific background/text color)
When isActive is false, returns a class string containing inactive state Tailwind classes
Return value is always a non-empty string

structured_side_effects.description: Pure function — returns a CSS class string based on boolean input.

invariants: Every value in ROUTE_SLUG_MAP starts with exactly one leading slash character ('/')
No slug value in ROUTE_SLUG_MAP produces a double-slash ('//') when used as a path
All RouteSlug values across ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST are unique — no two entries share the same slug
ROUTE_SLUG_MAP is derivable from ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST — they are never independently maintained
The first entry in ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST is always the home route with slug '/'
Sidebar renders exactly one NavLink per entry in ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST, in the same order
The home NavLink always uses the `end` prop to prevent matching all routes
Layout always renders Sidebar on the left and Outlet in the main content area
ensureLeadingSlash is a pure function with no side effects

data_access.rationale: Reads only public, static routing configuration data (step IDs, labels, slugs) defined at build time. No user data, PII, or secrets are accessed. The component produces purely presentational output (navigation links, layout containers) with no server-side data fetching or persistence.

side_effects.rationale: React Router v6 manipulates browser history state and window.location when users click NavLinks in the Sidebar. This is a client-side-only side effect with no server interaction.

authority.rationale: This component is the single source of truth for all URL slugs, route-to-step mappings, navigation ordering, and the top-level layout structure. No other component may define or modify route paths or navigation order.
